newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia net foreign reserves at $9.89 billion.
newsitem.headline: Colombia net foreign reserves at $9.89 billion.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves stood at $9.89 billion as of March 14 -- just $500,000 short of the historic high set at the end of 1996 -- the central bank said Friday.
Net reserves rose just $3.8 million between March 7 and March 14, due to a quicker-than-expected cut in short-term foreign debt repayments, the bank said.
Gross foreign reserves rose to a high of $10.13 billion as of the same date, $8.9 billion of which was invested in fixed-term deposits abroad.
The central bank forecast foreign reserves would grow by a total $750 million in 1997.
